fact: In December 2022 the Commission Nationale des Droits Humains (CNDH) had acquired a computerised complaints-management solution with an online complaint-filing platform, a toll-free number and a case database, and began regional briefings on its use.
title: Sensibilisation des journalistes et des acteurs de la société civile sur la solution informatique de gestion des plaintes de la CNDH
